title: Pancasila-Dilemmas: Evaluating Large Language Models on Indonesian Human Value Dilemmas Grounded in Pancasila
reasoning: The paper introduces the Pancasila-Dilemmas dataset to benchmark LLMs on Indonesian societal and moral dilemmas. It explicitly evaluates models across five core values, including 'Religion', 'Humanity', and 'Social Justice', assessing their capacity for moral reasoning and handling of culturally grounded ethical and religious conflicts.
